summary: Amber International Holding filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, announcing that its proposed acquisition of WhaleFin Markets Limited will not proceed. Amber DWM Holding, a wholly owned subsidiary, had agreed to acquire 100% of WhaleFin HK under a November 29, 2024 merger agreement, conditioned on Hong Kong SFC Type 1 and Type 7 licenses. The parties amended the framework agreement on October 16, 2026 to terminate the equity transfer. No price or termination fee was disclosed. Watch for strategic transformation execution risk and any remaining obligations under the framework agreement.
